title: City 20 — Custom Editor Tooling
description: Large-scale city-sim games generate project-specific data types that generic Unreal editors can't handle cleanly. Built custom UE editors in C++ and Blueprints for City 20's project-specific classes, then automated the full UE build pipeline with TeamCity and Python scripts covering build, test, and deployment stages. Also authored Gauntlet Framework test suites for multiplayer, UI, gameplay, and performance validation.

title: It Takes Two — Nintendo Switch Port
description: Hazelight's co-op platformer needed a reliable Nintendo Switch port without disrupting existing platform builds. Contributed as Tool & Generalist Programmer on the port, adapting tooling and build systems to meet Switch hardware and certification requirements alongside the core team at Untold Games.

title: Assetto Corsa Competizione — XSX & PS5
description: Porting a high-fidelity racing simulation to next-gen consoles requires a build system that handles platform-specific certification requirements without regression on existing targets. Contributed to the XSX and PS5 build system at Untold Games, enabling reliable console builds as part of the commercial release.
